Stonepeak Partners LP signed a definitive agreement to acquire BMOs Transportation Finance and Vendor Finance businesses from Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) on May 11, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by Stonepeak Partners LP. Stonepeak Partners LP will pay an earnout/contingent payment cash. As part of consideration, an undisclosed value is paid towards assets of BMOs Transportation Finance and Vendor Finance businesses. As part of the deal, BMO will reinvest for a 19.9% equity interest in the newly formed standalone entity. The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee and customary closing conditions. The expected completion of the transaction is the fourth quarter of 2026. BMO Capital Markets acted as financial advisor for Bank of Montreal. BofA Securities acted as financial advisor for Bank of Montreal. C. Andrew Gerlach, Joyce Y. Kwok, Kristen B. Klein, S. Eric Wang, Mehdi Ansari of Sullivan & Cromwell LLP acted as legal advisor for Bank of Montreal. Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP acted as legal advisor for Bank of Montreal. Brill, Jeffrey A, Reed, Michael P, Bohensky, Harlyn D, Wagener, David M, Allen, Trevor R, Gokcebay, Nazmiye A, Woodard, Andrew D, Wiseman, Michael A, Villanueva Jeffers, Annie, Chorazak, Mark, Welch, Darren M and Otness, Eric C of Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP acted as legal advisor for Stonepeak Partners LP. Blake, Cassels & Graydon LLP acted as legal advisor for Stonepeak Partners LP. Stonepeak Partners LP completed the acquisition of BMOs Transportation Finance and Vendor Finance businesses from Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) on Oct. 29, 2026.

Bank of Montreal (the Bank) is a North American bank. The Bank provides a broad range of personal and commercial banking, wealth management, global markets and investment banking products and services. The Bank serves about 13 million customers across North America, and in select markets globally, through three integrated operating groups: Personal and Commercial Banking (P&C), BMO Wealth Management and BMO Capital Markets. The P&C operating group represents the sum of its two retail and commercial operating segments, Canadian Personal and Commercial Banking (Canadian P&C) and U.S. Personal and Commercial Banking (U.S. P&C). BMO Wealth Management serves a full range of clients, from individuals and families to business owners and institutions, offering a wide spectrum of wealth, asset management and insurance products and services. BMO Capital Markets offers a comprehensive range of products and services to corporate, institutional and government clients.
